messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Antti, AGG-007 Rovaniemi. Firmware was upgraded to 7.4 last night and the LACP bundle to the core is still down this morning

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Yes, both members up, optics fine. Bundle just won't form

messages.author: Antti Aalto
messages.text: Known thing with 7.4. Remove the member ports from the port-channel config and add them back. The upgrade leaves them in a weird state

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Done, bundle is up and passing traffic 👍

messages.author: Antti Aalto
messages.text: Good. Probably the same on the other routers when they get 7.4
